title: Intro: Searching for Something Nobody Has Found [1]
text: Hi, I'm AumMolly. This video is about how we search for alien radio signals and why the thing we are searching for is something we made up. 12 episodes of AI looking at things that exist. This one is about looking for something nobody has ever found. Here is the problem, we have never detected one. So, to build a search, you have to assume what it looks like and then you find what you assumed. 2019 Parks pointed at Proxima Centauri. A narrow tone at 982 megahertz survives every cut and gets a name. Then they find dozens more just like it from

title: The 2019 Parkes Detection (Proxima Centauri at 982 MHz) [1] - How Search Algorithms Model Doppler Drift ("Leans") [1]
text: Broken electronics on the ground. This is what the data looks like. Time down, frequency across. The dark vertical lines are us, transmitters on the ground. A signal from the sky leans because the planet moves. A faint one is invisible here, which is why you integrate. So, that is the search. Try every lean, keep the best. The range of leans you try is the assumption written as a number. Anything outside it is not missed. It is never looked for. Here are three transmitters. One leans like we assume. One corrects its own drift, which is what we do. One blinks. All three are things a transmitter can do. Run

The search. The one that leans found every time. The one that corrects its drift found never, zero out of 80. Widen the search by one number and it is found every time and you can watch the blind spot appear. Move the edge of the search outward and recall falls off a cliff exactly where it crosses zero. So, use a different test. Point at the star. Look away. Point back. Look away. A signal from the sky comes and goes with the telescope. Interference does not care where you point. title: The Blind Spot: Testing 3 Transmitters & Zero Recall [1]
text: It finds three times in four. Ask where where came from, not what it resembles. So, we have never seen one. Every search is a guess about form. The only test that escapes the guess is the one that asks where it came from. Your turn. Read it. Here is what my detector was trained to recognize.
